rows.en: A rookie operator whose natural cheer makes up for her inexperience. Her looks and manner make her seem younger than she is, which really bothers her. (CV: Kimiko Koyama)
rows.notes: Identified as Yuu Akimizu (rookie operator; female CV). Compressed to fit 3 lines.

rows.en: A big-sister operator whose orders are sometimes gentle, sometimes strict, always on point. A bit pushy but caring, she is popular with the crew as an admired big sister. (CV: Yuu Adachi)
rows.notes: Identified as Claire Stanford (big-sister operator; female CV). Compressed to fit 3 lines.

rows.en: A skilled operator who reads battles calmly. His blunt words to pilots get him misunderstood, but he's just bad at showing feelings and is truly kind. Glasses are his trademark. (CV: Kiyotaka Furushima)
rows.notes: Identified as Itsuki Yamashiro (male CV, glossary gender male). 'jou ni atsui' rendered 'truly kind' to fit 3 lines.

rows.en: A U.N. Forces Lt. and air combat controller on the Macross bridge. A by-the-book stickler, she was treated as an "old lady" by Hikaru, but slowly came to have feelings for him. (CV: Mika Doi)
rows.notes: Misa Hayase profile.
